source_title: Nano-flowered manganese doped ferrite@PANI composite as energy storage electrode material for supercapacitors

context_items.content: MnFe2O4 nano-ferrites were prepared by hydrothermal method using stoichiometric FeCl3.6H2O and MnCl2, pH adjusted to 12 with 5 M NaOH, hydrothermal treatment at 145 C for 24 hours, and drying at 60 C overnight.
Composition, morphology and structure were characterized using XRD, FE-SEM, HR-TEM and XPS. Electrochemical properties were studied using CV, EIS and GCD instrumentation.

The electrochemical performance of PANI and different MnFe2O4@PANI compositions was examined in 1 M H2SO4. Fig. 5a compares specific capacitance and states that 10% MnFe2O4@PANI gave the highest specific capacitance, followed by 20% and 50%.
